# Visual walkthrough

Read the [standard](../../../docs/standards/delivery.md), profile and journey ACs.
Reuse an available local page/server; do not stop another user's process.
If starting a server is authorised, verify responsiveness before using it.

Exercise changed happy, negative and boundary journeys with real controls.
Use accessibility snapshots for interaction; screenshots supplement, not replace,
behavioural checks. Record URL/environment, steps, expected/actual results and
relevant AC IDs. Avoid committing sensitive or bulky incidental artefacts.

Missing browser/device capability is Unverified, not a pass. No UI/journey change
may be Not applicable with an explicit reason.

Output: walkthrough evidence and remaining device/accessibility gaps for G3.
